---
title: "Clustering"
---

Clustering with kohonen SOM or FastPG.

## `sw_cluster` {#sw_cluster}

Cluster cells using a self-organizing map (kohonen) or graph-based clustering (FastPG).

### Usage

```r
sw_cluster(corrected, lineage_markers, method = c("som", "fastpg"),
           xdim = 10, ydim = 10, n_metaclusters = 20, seed = 42, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `corrected` | A `data.frame`/`tibble` or matrix of expression values. |
| `lineage_markers` | Character vector of marker columns to use for clustering. |
| `method` | Clustering method: `"som"` (default, uses kohonen) or `"fastpg"` (uses FastPG). |
| `xdim` | SOM grid x-dimension (default: 10). Only used when `method = "som"`. |
| `ydim` | SOM grid y-dimension (default: 10). Only used when `method = "som"`. |
| `n_metaclusters` | Number of metaclusters (default: 20). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `kohonen::som()` or `FastPG::fastcluster()`. |

### Details

When `method = "som"`, trains a self-organizing map using the kohonen package
and applies hierarchical metaclustering on the SOM codes. When
`method = "fastpg"`, uses FastPG graph-based clustering (requires the FastPG
package to be installed).

### Value

An `sw_cluster_result` S3 object containing the trained model and cluster assignments.

---

## `sw_get_cluster_assignments` {#sw_get_cluster_assignments}

Get cluster assignments.

### Usage

```r
sw_get_cluster_assignments(cluster_result)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cluster_result` | An `sw_cluster_result` object from `sw_cluster()`. |

### Details

Extracts per-cell cluster assignments from an `sw_cluster_result`.

### Value

An integer vector of cluster assignments, one per cell.

---

## `sw_cluster_mfis` {#sw_cluster_mfis}

Compute median fluorescence intensities per cluster.

### Usage

```r
sw_cluster_mfis(cluster_result)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cluster_result` | An `sw_cluster_result` object from `sw_cluster()`. |

### Details

Calculates the median expression of each marker within each cluster.

### Value

A `tibble` with one row per cluster and one column per marker, plus a
`cluster` column.

---

## `sw_plot_clusters` {#sw_plot_clusters}

Plot cluster heatmap.

### Usage

```r
sw_plot_clusters(cluster_result, plot_file = "clusters.pdf")
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cluster_result` | An `sw_cluster_result` object from `sw_cluster()`. |
| `plot_file` | Output file path (default: `"clusters.pdf"`). |

### Details

Generates a heatmap of median marker expression per cluster using pheatmap
(if available) or base R `heatmap()`, and saves it to a file.

### Value

The file path (invisibly).

---

## `sw_predict_clusters` {#sw_predict_clusters}

Predict clusters for new data using a trained model.

### Usage

```r
sw_predict_clusters(cluster_result, new_data)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cluster_result` | A trained `sw_cluster_result` object from `sw_cluster()`. |
| `new_data` | A `data.frame`, `tibble`, or matrix of new expression data. |

### Details

Projects new samples onto an existing trained clustering model and returns
cluster assignments for the new data.

### Value

An integer vector of predicted cluster assignments for the new data.
